texts.zh:
方舟舰[Root.GetName]上的气氛异常紧张，入围者们正在[Star.GetName]进行最后的弹射。

[selected_pilot.GetName]紧随领头者，直到最后的冲刺阶段才找到机会，凭借其精准的路线和精彩的超越，[selected_pilot.GetSheHe]一骑绝尘，将对手甩在[selected_pilot.GetHerHis]的离子尾流中。
texts.en:
The atmosphere aboard Arkship [Root.GetName] was palpable as the finalists hit the last slingshot around [Star.GetName].

[selected_pilot.GetName] shadowed the leader until the final sprint, then found one last burst. With crisp lines and a brilliant overtake, [selected_pilot.GetSheHe] slipped ahead and left the field in [selected_pilot.GetHerHis] ion wake.

texts.zh:
方舟舰[Root.GetName]上的气氛异常紧张，入围者们正在[Star.GetName]进行最后的弹射。

小灰在最后冲刺前一直紧随领头者，随后他爆发出了最后的能量。以精准的线路和精彩的超越，他们领先冲过终点线，将其他选手远远甩在了离子尾流中。
texts.en:
The atmosphere aboard Arkship [Root.GetName] was palpable as the finalists hit the last slingshot around [Star.GetName].

Gray shadowed the leader until the final sprint, then found one last burst. With crisp lines and a brilliant overtake, they slipped ahead and left the field in their ion wake.

texts.zh:
方舟舰[Root.GetName]上的气氛异常紧张，入围者们正在[Star.GetName]进行最后的弹射。

我们的飞行员紧随领头者，直到最后的冲刺，然后爆发出最后一股力量。凭借清晰的路线和出色的超越，他们领先并让其他飞船远远落在他们的离子尾流中。
texts.en:
The atmosphere aboard Arkship [Root.GetName] was palpable as the finalists hit the last slingshot around [Star.GetName].

Our pilot shadowed the leader until the final sprint, then found one last burst. With crisp lines and a brilliant overtake, they slipped ahead and left the field in their ion wake.

label.zh: 我们可以向赢家学习！
label.en: We can learn from our winner!

label.zh: 应该为[selected_pilot.GetName]庆祝！
label.en: [selected_pilot.GetName] should be celebrated!

texts.zh:
方舟舰[Root.GetName]上的气氛异常紧张，入围者们正在[Star.GetName]进行最后的弹射。

[selected_pilot.GetName]在进入机动动作时保持着明显的领先优势，但这种优势随后开始消退。

出了点差错，可能是失误、操作不当，或者仅仅是由于紧张。总之，对手轻松反超，我们的飞行员最终只落得个平淡无奇的第四名。
texts.en:
The atmosphere aboard Arkship [Root.GetName] was palpable as the finalists hit the last slingshot around [Star.GetName].

[selected_pilot.GetName] held a clear lead entering the manouver, but the edge began to fade.

Something slipped, a missed mark, a loose line, maybe just nerves. Either way their rivals eased past and our pilot crossed the finish in an unremarkable fourth.

texts.zh:
围绕方舟舰[Root.GetName]的竞赛以悲剧告终，一场高速碰撞导致碎片散落在整个恒星系中。在对准绕[Star.GetName]的最后一次引力弹射航线时，我们的飞行员与对手靠得太近，导致两艘飞船都失控旋转。

[selected_pilot.GetName]由于救援及时幸存了下来，但伤势严重，将留下永久的伤疤。
texts.en:
The race around Arkship [Root.GetName] ended in tragedy when a high-speed collision scattered debris across the system. While lining up the final slingshot around [Star.GetName], our pilot closed too tightly on a rival and both ships spun out.

[selected_pilot.GetName] survived thanks to rapid rescue, but suffered severe injuries and will carry lasting scars.

texts.zh:
围绕方舟舰[Root.GetName]的竞赛以悲剧告终，一场高速碰撞导致碎片散落在整个恒星系中。在对准绕[Star.GetName]的最后一次引力弹射航线时，我们的飞行员与对手靠得太近，导致两艘飞船都失控旋转。

我们的候选人因救援及时得以幸存，但伤势严重，并将留下永久的伤疤。
texts.en:
The race around Arkship [Root.GetName] ended in tragedy when a high-speed collision scattered debris across the system. While lining up the final slingshot around [Star.GetName], our pilot closed too tightly on a rival and both ships spun out.

Our candidate survived thanks to rapid rescue, but suffered severe injuries and will carry lasting scars.

label.zh: 真是坏消息……
label.en: Terrible news...

texts.zh:
方舟舰[Root.GetName]上的气氛异常紧张，入围者们正在[Star.GetName]进行最后的弹射。

由于我们选中的飞行员完美地执行了机动动作，胜利似乎已是囊中之物，直到那艘“黑貂号”闪现而过。一艘此前未标记、也未被注意到的参赛船只从我们的领先者身边掠过，并率先冲过了终点线。

在[Root.GetName]上，面对这残酷的结局，观礼台陷入了一片死寂。
texts.en:
The atmosphere aboard Arkship [Root.GetName] was palpable as the finalists hit the last slingshot around [Star.GetName].

Our selected pilot's victory seemed assured as they executed the maneuver flawlessly, until the Sable Ship flashed by. An unmarked, until-then unnoticed entrant swept past our front-runner and crossed the line first.

Aboard the [Root.GetName], the galleries fell silent at the brutal finish.

label.zh: 我们要黑貂号的飞行员！
label.en: We want the pilot of the Sable Ship!

summary.text:
# 启动引擎 / Start Your Engines

- 分类 Category：银河轶事 C8 stories · 来源 Sources：events/nomads_arkship_events.txt、common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt、common/special_projects/06_projects_nomads.txt、common/event_chains/00_event_chains_nomads.txt · 游牧帝国内容 nomad content · 审阅 Reviewed 2026-10-13

## 如何开始 How it starts

游牧帝国的方舟随机事件：隐藏事件 arkship.1（nomads_arkship_events.txt:7-49）定期检查，游戏前5年不会发生，每次约三分之一几率（中期前×1.5；近期参战或所有方舟都在战斗时为0）调用 generate_arkship_event 从 mobile_arkship_random_events 池（00_on_actions.txt:3979-4006，24项，总权重460）中抽取一件，否则3–5年后再试。多数事件设置一次性标记（个别如“出发！”可发生两次）；结束后约10–15年再重新开始检查。（池中权重 20/460，00_on_actions.txt:3983）
Nomad arkship random event: hidden arkship.1 (nomads_arkship_events.txt:7-49) checks periodically — never in the first 5 years, about one in three (×1.5 before mid game, 0 during recent war or when every arkship is fighting) — and draws one episode from mobile_arkship_random_events (00_on_actions.txt:3979-4006, 24 entries, total weight 460); otherwise it retries in 3–5 years. Most episodes set a once-only flag (Start Your Engines can happen twice); after it ends the loop resumes roughly 10–15 years later. (pool weight 20/460, 00_on_actions.txt:3983)

条件：非格式塔；至少与两个常规帝国有通讯；整局最多两次（第一次之后35年内不会再发生，arkship.65 immediate）。
Conditions: non-gestalt; communications with at least two regular empires; at most twice per game (blocked for 35 years after the first).

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

- 方舟主办一场持续近一年的星际竞速。按本国领袖与特质出现不同的参赛人选（共22种选项，多数需特定领袖特质或国策），约半年后（经隐藏事件75）出现结果：
  The arkship hosts a year-long race; the pilot options depend on our leaders and traits (22 options); about six months later (via hidden 75) the result:
- “[方舟]大捷”（70，基础20）、“糟糕表现”（80，60）、“骇人听闻的意外”（85，16）、“神秘飞行员”（90，4，可招募神秘飞行员）。
  Victory (70, base 20), Terrible Performance (80, 60), Horrific Accident (85, 16), Mysterious Pilot (90, 4; the pilot can be hired).

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

- 四种结果互斥；人选影响权重。
  The four results are exclusive; the chosen pilot changes the weights.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

- 无特殊差异。
  No notable variants.

## 审阅记录 Review notes

- 已核对 Checked：方舟事件循环 arkship.1 与随机池权重、本事件的触发条件与一次性标记、各选项的后续事件/项目与随机权重、延迟（@extremely_short_arkship_event_delay_days = 180 天，10_scripted_variables_nomads.txt:457）。
  Checked the arkship loop and pool weights, this episode's trigger and once-flag, options, projects, random weights and delays (180 days base).
- 说明 Note：地图上的延迟显示为未解析的脚本变量名，实际值见上（编译器请求）。
  Map delays show unresolved script variables; values are given above.
